name: Librarian

sections.daily_work: Help patrons find information and resources. Manage collections and cataloging. Run community programs. Teach information literacy. Preserve archives.
sections.learning: Library science (MLIS degree), information organization, cataloging systems, digital resource management, community programming, research skills.
sections.pay: Entry-level typically starts around $40,000-$55,000 USD. With MLIS degree: $50,000-$80,000. Directors can earn $90,000+. Verify for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Volunteer at a local library, bachelor's degree in any field, Master of Library and Information Science (MLIS), library assistant positions, specializing in archives or digital libraries.

try_in_real_life: Volunteer at your school or local library
Explore the Dewey Decimal or Library of Congress classification system
Ask a librarian about their career path and daily work
Research MLIS programs and their admission requirements
sources: American Library Association salary surveys; U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
